title: Replay-safe retries, idempotency reconciliation, and request correlation for Hosted API
creator: Nina Patel
description: During an escalated outage for a large enterprise tenant we recorded a clustered wave of HTTP 5xx and long tail timeouts. Customer traffic included concurrent streaming requests with identical client idempotency tokens. The edge layer aggressively retried mid-stream connections after a proxy reset while the runtime replay detector had already accepted and processed a request, producing duplicate outputs and duplicate billing events. This ticket captures investigation notes, a short-term production-safe patch to make retries replay-safe for streaming and non-idempotent endpoints, and longer-term platform changes (token lifetime alignment, SDK guidance, tracing/correlation improvements).
steps_to_reproduce: Create a tenant-scoped traffic generator that issues 100 concurrent streaming generate calls with the same idempotency key header.
At t=5s, inject a TCP RST between the edge proxy and runtime (simulate transient proxy overload).
Have the client SDK automatically retry on connection errors without renewing the idempotency token.
Observe duplicate completion events and increased billed token counts in billing logs.
Repeat with short-lived idempotency token expiry at edge to emulate mismatch.
observed_logs: edge-proxy: connection-split detected, client-id=acct-42, correlation=cid-8a7f, retrying in 120ms
edge-proxy: retry dispatched for tok-123, new-conn id=conn-91, correlation=cid-8a7f
billing: duplicate-charge detected for tenant acct-42 run-0a12 and run-0b13
root_cause: Mismatch between edge idempotency token lifecycle and runtime replay detector window plus aggressive connection-reset/retry behavior in the proxy. Circuit-breaker layer prematurely closed connections under backpressure, losing in-flight stream state and causing clients to retransmit with identical tokens while the runtime lacked a deterministic replay-safe stream resume path.
mitigation: Hotfix deployed (edge): hold client idempotency header for 60s and attach strong correlation id to retried attempts (deployed 2026-03-03 03:20 UTC).
Hotfix deployed (runtime): treat streaming requests with an explicit replay-phase handshake; reject replay attempts with 409 + replay-info when duplicate detected (deployed 2026-03-04 01:10 UTC).
Temporarily increased circuit-breaker timeout thresholds for the affected frontline proxies to reduce mid-stream resets.
Added automated alert: high ratio of completed traces with same idempotency token across distinct runtime request ids.
Customer communication sent describing root cause, mitigation, and refund plan for duplicate billing entries.
follow_up_tasks: Align idempotency token TTLs between SDK/edge and runtime; propose default 5 minute TTL and document in SDK release notes.
Implement persistent replay ledger in runtime for streaming requests to allow safe resume and deduplication across short interruptions.
Add end-to-end correlation propagation: ensure correlation-id is honored through proxy, gateway, and runtime and surfaced in logs/dashboards.
Instrument billing pipeline to tag and suppress known replay duplicates before charging customers; run reconciliation sweep for impacted tenant.
Update client SDKs to expose explicit retry modes: safe-replay, no-replay, idempotent-only and publish migration guidance.
Run chaos test in staging that simulates proxy resets and verifies deduplication for streaming cases.
Schedule postmortem review with customer success and legal to finalize remediation and credits.
